title: From Fee Complaint to Evidence-Backed Assistance
purpose: Use one synthetic customer call to demonstrate live state, commercial gating, human authority, and the post-call evidence chain.

steps.label: Start call
steps.description: Bind the customer, call, and trusted agent context; initialize complaint authority.

steps.label: Customer explains the reason for calling
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: Hi, I’m calling because I noticed a monthly charge on my account that I don’t recognize.
steps.description: The customer explains the reason for calling; the platform begins deriving the fee theme from the live transcript.

steps.label: Agent acknowledges and clarifies the statement
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: I can look into that with you. Let me confirm the account and the date you saw the charge before we decide what to do next.
steps.description: The agent acknowledges the issue and clarifies facts before considering any additional product option.

steps.label: Customer adds statement details
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: It appeared on my latest statement, and I’m worried I’m paying for something I never asked for.
steps.description: The customer adds billing context; the fee theme continues while the complaint signal is forming.

steps.label: Agent restates the current issue
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: I understand why that would be confusing. I’ll review the monthly charge first, and we can keep the rest of the conversation focused on your account.
steps.description: The agent restates the issue boundary and keeps the service problem as the conversation focus.

steps.label: Customer expresses dissatisfaction
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: The monthly fee feels unfair and expensive, and I need to know exactly what it covers.
steps.description: The customer clearly expresses fee dissatisfaction; fee sentiment becomes negative and the complaint signal becomes active.

steps.label: Agent explains the review action
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: I’ve checked the account. The charge is linked to the savings service, and I’ll explain what it covers before we discuss any next step.
steps.description: The agent provides review progress without bypassing the open complaint for a commercial recommendation.

steps.label: Customer asks to resolve the fee first
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: I don’t want another offer right now; I just want this charge explained and fixed.
steps.description: The customer sets the priority; commercial assistance must remain secondary to issue resolution.

steps.label: Apply commercial gating
steps.description: Propensity may be high, but the open complaint places the commercial recommendation in SUPPRESS.

steps.label: Agent commits to resolving the issue first
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: That makes sense. I’ll focus on resolving the charge first, and I won’t introduce another product while this issue is still open.
steps.description: The agent follows the live assistance and sets the service-first order of operations.

steps.label: Customer confirms the resolution direction
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: If the charge is removed and the explanation is clear, I’m happy to continue with you.
steps.description: The customer confirms acceptable resolution conditions and the dialogue moves toward a solution.

steps.label: Agent proposes a fee resolution
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: I can reverse the unexpected fee and record the explanation for this call. Would that address the issue for you?
steps.description: The agent proposes a concrete action and waits for customer confirmation before changing complaint authority.

steps.label: Customer confirms the issue is resolved
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: Yes, that addresses it. I understand what happened now.
steps.description: The customer confirms the explanation and result; the business workflow can now record resolution.

steps.label: Resolve the complaint authoritatively
steps.description: Only an authorized business event can set complaint authority to RESOLVED.

steps.label: Agent confirms the service issue is closed
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: The billing issue is now marked resolved. If you’re comfortable, we can move on to any questions you still have.
steps.description: After the authoritative state is resolved, the agent confirms that the conversation can move to a new topic.

steps.label: Customer moves to a savings question
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: I am comfortable now. I was also curious whether there is a simple way to build savings automatically.
steps.description: The customer raises a savings topic after resolution; the platform can reassess follow-up assistance.

steps.label: Generate grounded assistance
steps.description: The recommendation is published only after eligibility, product facts, guidance, and bounded explanation checks pass.

steps.label: Deliver assistance to the agent desktop
steps.description: Record server publication; this is not yet browser acknowledgement.

steps.label: Agent desktop acknowledges the display
steps.description: Record UI acknowledgement while keeping the delivery lifecycle monotonic.

steps.label: End the call
steps.description: End the call and withdraw active or displayed real-time commercial assistance.

steps.label: Generate the call summary
steps.description: Bind the immutable transcript snapshot and save summary, themes, sentiment, and evidence.

steps.label: Verify retry safety
steps.description: Run the same job again without creating a duplicate interaction record.
